title: Villa Anesi
meta_description: Villa Azela is a luxury 5-bedroom multi-level retreat with ocean views, private pool, rooftop lounge, game room, and prime location within walking distance to the beach ---perfect for large groups!
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Meet Villa Anesi---your multi-level beachside escape built for sun, style, and unforgettable group getaways. With five bedrooms, panoramic Gulf views, and luxe amenities throughout, this vibrant retreat was designed to impress at every level---literally. The heart of the home is on the second floor, where coastal-chic interiors and an open-concept main living area invite relaxation. The chef's kitchen is a dream, equipped with stainless steel appliances, a standalone ice maker, and a Cuisinart Duo coffee maker. Craving a little poolside bliss? Step outside to the private pool and patio with sun loungers, a grill, and Sonos speakers to soundtrack your soak, or hop in the included 6-seater golf cart to cruise to the beach and enjoy the area with ease. On the third floor, you'll find three King bedrooms, each with ensuite bathrooms featuring double vanities and sleek walk-in showers. Two of these rooms offer balcony access, making it easy to greet the morning with a salty breeze. The fourth floor is all about fun and flexibility. It features a second living area, cozy kitchenette (with beverage fridge, sink, and Keurig), a game table, arcade game, and two bunk rooms---one with a Queen over King, and the other with Twin/Twin and Full/Full bunks plus balcony access. At the top? Your private crown jewel: a rooftop deck with a covered lounge area, propane fire pit table, cornhole, and jaw-dropping panoramic ocean views---the ultimate spot for sunset cocktails and starry hangs. Whether you're here to relax, explore, or entertain, Villa Anesi offers the space and setting to do it all in style.

ABOUT THE AREA: Dune Allen can be described as laid-back old Florida. With miles of trails, five coastal dune lakes and sprawling beaches, it's a nature lovers dream. Just a short drive to Gulf Place shops, makes it perfect for families who don't like the crowds and restrictions of other 30A beaches yet close to it all.

BEACH ACCESS: Dune Allen Regional Beach Access is the closest beach access. It's right across from Stinky's Fish Camp Restaurant. (5999 W Co Hwy 30-A, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459). This beach has restrooms, parking, a lifeguard station, and is ADA accessible. A little further to the East on 30A is Fort Panic Regional Access. This beach is also ADA accessible, has parking, restrooms, and lifeguard.

ACCOMMODATIONS: 5 Bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms
• Bedroom 1 -- King bed, ensuite bathroom (3rd Floor)
• Bedroom 2 -- King bed, ensuite bathroom (3rd Floor)
• Bedroom 3 -- King bed, ensuite bathroom (3rd Floor)
• Bedroom 4 -- Bunk Room -- 1 twin/twin, 1 full/full (4th Floor)
• Bedroom 5 -- Bunk Room -- 1 queen/king (4th Floor)

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Pet Friendly ($250/pet NR fee)
• 6-Seater Golf Cart
• 2 Bicycles
• 5-minute walk to Dune Allen Beach Access
• Rooftop deck w/ ocean views, fire pit, lounge seating, \& cornhole
• 5 bedrooms: 3 King ensuite bedrooms, 2 bunk rooms
• Private pool, poolside patio with grill
• 2 living rooms, arcade \& game table
• Fully stocked chef's kitchen w/ ice maker \& coffee bar
• Full size washer/dryer

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- This home allows up to 2 pets under 30 lbs each for a fee; undisclosed pets brought without AvantStay's approval may result in a $500 fine.
- This home comes with a pack n' play travel crib.
- There is an inflatable paddle board, pump, and 8 beach chairs available for guest use.
- There is an elevator that can be used for the 2nd-4th floors.
- Guests must be 25 years or older to book this home.
- Pool heat is a paid feature and must be requested 24-48 hours before the day of check-in.

Parking Details:
- 4 parking spaces available.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
